## ✨ Highlights

- 🔒 **HAProxy security update, every branch**: HAProxy 3.4.7, 3.2.26 and 3.0.30 fix two vulnerabilities rated high in all three - a too long chunk-size line in an HTTP/1 request or response, and short reads of HTTP/2 PING frames - and a third in 3.4 (userlist sections in the configuration). Update every node, whatever HAProxy branch its image has.

## 🔒 Security

- **HAProxy 3.4 3.4.6 → 3.4.7** (nodes on HAProxy 3.4 - the default HAProxy branch, or pinned to it):
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-61978ef](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.4.git;a=commitdiff;h=61978ef) - BUG/MAJOR: h1-htx: report an error on a too long chunk-size line - HTTP/1 chunked messages, from clients or servers;
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-b8a5ea6](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.4.git;a=commitdiff;h=b8a5ea6) - BUG/MAJOR: mux-h2: properly handle short reads on PING frames - every HTTP/2 listener or server;
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-14f9aa9](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.4.git;a=commitdiff;h=14f9aa9) - BUG/MAJOR: cfgparse: properly check userlist section when scanning keywords - configurations with a `userlist`;
  - 5 more don't apply to Janus's build (the files they change aren't compiled in); 48 other bug fixes.
- **HAProxy 3.2 3.2.25 → 3.2.26** (nodes pinned to HAProxy 3.2):
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-a5f625b](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.2.git;a=commitdiff;h=a5f625b) - BUG/MAJOR: h1-htx: report an error on a too long chunk-size line;
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-dc338d8](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.2.git;a=commitdiff;h=dc338d8) - BUG/MAJOR: mux-h2: properly handle short reads on PING frames;
  - 3 more don't apply to Janus's build; 41 other bug fixes.
- **HAProxy 3.0 3.0.29 → 3.0.30** (nodes pinned to HAProxy 3.0):
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-fd0864b](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.0.git;a=commitdiff;h=fd0864b) - BUG/MAJOR: h1-htx: report an error on a too long chunk-size line;
  - 🟠 high [haproxy-560f101](https://git.haproxy.org/?p=haproxy-3.0.git;a=commitdiff;h=560f101) - BUG/MAJOR: mux-h2: properly handle short reads on PING frames;
  - 3 more don't apply to Janus's build; 32 other bug fixes.

The Controller's update badge (🔒) shows on every node until it runs this release: each HAProxy branch has a fix.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Nodes**: the usual A/B update - a node keeps its HAProxy branch. A custom image (the factory) of this release has the new HAProxy of its branch.
- **The Controller**: nothing changed beyond the version - it shows the 🔒 badge for the nodes to update.
- **janusctl**: nothing changed beyond the version.
- **The Terraform provider**: nothing changed.

📖 Docs: [Updating nodes](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/updates.md) · [How upstreams are followed](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/upstreams.md) · [Security policy](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
